2634.title: Codex follow-up work loses accepted-turn correlation
2634.rootCauseOneLine: A fixed timer consumes the request correlation before a delayed real turn starts.
2634.proposedFix: Use the turn identity from the turn/start response and suppress its later duplicate start notification.
2634.caveats: The test used an agent-message work item instead of a native agent tool call. Both use the same real turn lifecycle.
